subject: Post-demo recap & next steps: SOC 2 / pen test + stakeholder map (Novacorp)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@novacorp.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps: SOC 2 / pen test + stakeholder map (Novacorp)

Hi Julia / Mark —

Great to meet today — appreciate the time and the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

- Key value: Reduce inference cost and meet 99th pct latency SLOs for your customer-facing search experience (demo showed ~35% cost reduction in our infra tests).
- Decision criteria you called out: SLA (uptime + latency), security evidence (SOC 2 / pen test / audit logs), and procurement-friendly terms.

Next steps I propose:
1) Stakeholder map — you to confirm economic buyer (you mentioned Mark for budget) and security/legal/procurement contacts.
2) Security evidence delivery — we can share SOC 2 report and pen test summary this week; we’ll also provide a sample audit log CSV and retention policy doc.
3) Procurement timeline — let us know any specific contract redlines or PO workflow; Procurement team can loop in on the thread.

Action items:
- Julia: please confirm stakeholders + procurement timeline by EOD Wed (7/15).
- Marissa (cc’d): will collate SOC 2 / pen test / logs and upload to shared Drive once Julia confirms recipients.
- Ben: will prepare a one-page mutual action plan and propose dates for a security/technical deep dive.

Attachments: none yet — will follow once Marissa pulls the artifacts.

Thanks again — happy to jump on another call if it’s helpful.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@novacorp.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps: SOC 2 / pen test + stakeholder map (Novacorp)

Thanks Ben — good recap. Confirming stakeholders on our side: 

- Economic buyer: Mark Chen (VP Product, cc’d)
- Security: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novacorp.com> (InfoSec manager)
- Legal: Andrew Lopez <andrew.lopez@novacorp.com>
- Procurement / SOW: procurement@novacorp.com

Procurement timeline:
- Initial evidence review (SOC 2 + pen test summary + sample logs): this week preferred.
- Formal security questionnaire (we’ll share our vendor security form) + legal review: target by 7/28.
- PO / contract: procurement prefers to have standard terms; any material redlines should be surfaced before legal review.

We’d appreciate the SOC 2 + pen test summary and a short note on retention/audit logs by EOD Thu (7/16). Mark — can you confirm budget timing?

Julia
Julia Ramos
Director, Platform Engineering | Novacorp
From: Procurement Team <procurement@novacorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps: SOC 2 / pen test + stakeholder map (Novacorp)

Ben —

Thanks for the intro. A few procurement items to confirm so we can scope the PO/terms: 

1) Are you able to accept our standard Net 60 payment terms and provide a commercial invoice?
2) Do you require any special contract clauses (data residency, export controls) beyond standard SOW?
3) Please provide a point of contact for procurement integration and an expected timeline for finalizing SOW (we’d like something in the 2–3 week range after legal review).

Also please include DocuSign readiness (yes/no) — we prefer e-sign for speed.

Procurement Team
Novacorp
procurement@novacorp.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@novacorp.com>, Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@novacorp.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps: SOC 2 / pen test + stakeholder map (Novacorp)

Hi Procurement / Julia / Mark —

Quick answers inline: 
1) Payment terms: We typically publish Net 30 on hosted accounts, but we can support Net 60 on enterprise committed deals — happy to include in the SOW.
2) Contract clauses: Standard SOW with data processing addendum covers residency/export; if you have specific language please share and we’ll escalate to legal.
3) Procurement POC: Ben Carter (me) and Marissa Cole (contracts/evidence). Target timeline: draft SOW within 1 week after legal inputs -> finalization 2–3 weeks after legal review.

DocuSign: yes — we support DocuSign for enterprise agreements.

Attaching: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (redacted), Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2026-05.pdf, audit_logs_sample_2026-06.csv

Marissa — can you confirm you uploaded these to the shared Drive and flag anything sensitive we should mark for restricted access?

Thanks —
Ben

Proposed next call: security deep dive with Priya Shah + Andrew Lopez + Marissa on Tue 7/21 at 10:00am PT — does that work for your team?

Thanks
